text: On the exhale dissolve your body, on the inhale gather it anew.Begin consciously to breathe, feeling that you are breathing with your heart. With each exhale, imagine how the boundaries of your body melt, and you become one with the space around you. Complete dissolution. With each inhale, imagine how from this space you gather your body anew, fresh, healthy, renewed. At the same time, expand and reassemble all the subtle bodies - that is, renew yourself at the level of emotions, thoughts, values, and even life events. This practice not only powerfully cleanses and harmonizes you, but at the same time your mind gets used to the fact that your form is not fixed, but represents a fluid, constantly re-created dance of energies.
